name: Flame Tyrant
description: The flame tyrant is an infernal humanoid-like creature with a distinct ram-skull head that is known to wreath itself in hellfire. They are typically servants of high powers that bring their master's justice upon those unlucky beings. These creatures wield heavy armor and a menacing array of weapons and don black cloaks that make them nearly impossible to spot while not ignited.

actions.name: Infernal Flail
actions.description: The flame tyrant swings it's flail at a target within 2 units, dealing physical and fire damage.

actions.name: Heart Piercer
actions.description: The flame tyrant throws an infernal dagger at a creature within 8 units, dealing a small amount of physical damage. If hit, this dagger remains lodged within the target unless pulled out with a strength check of 12 or higher in which case, the dagger reappears back in the flame tyrant's hand allowing them to take this Free Action again. At the end of each turn while this dagger is lodged within them, the affected creature takes dark damage.

actions.name: Ignis
actions.description: The flame tyrant ignites itself with hellfire which can only be doused by magic, gaining the ignited condition. If there is an open flame within 8 units, the flame tyrant can teleport to that location, causing the flame in that area to be converted to hellfire.

actions.name: Annihilation Field
actions.description: The flame tyrant causes a pulse of dark energy to spread around them in a 3 unit radius, dealing dark damage. Any creature who takes damage from this attack after mitigation becomes marked until the end of their next turn. While marked, the first time that creature takes physical damage, they take an additional 2d8.

actions.name: Concussive Strike
actions.description: Before using the Infernal Flail action, the flame tyrant aims at the creature's head. The next Infernal Flail action receives a 1d4 penalty but stuns the target if it deals physical damage after mitigations are calculated.

traits.name: Wreathed in Flame
traits.description: While ignited, the flame tyrant gains a 1d4 bonus to all defensive checks.

traits.name: Cloak of Shadows
traits.description: While not ignited, the flame tyrant gains a +5 bonus to stealth checks.
